college.name: Aravali Institute of Technology
college.portal: the campus site (students just 'visit the campus site'; there is no web address to give out)
college.classes: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM-4:30 PM, lunch 12:50-1:40 PM; Saturday labs/clubs only; Sunday off
college.offices_open: Mon-Fri 9:30 AM-5:30 PM, Sat 9:30 AM-1 PM

exams.marks: Each theory subject is 100: internal 40 (mid-sem 20, quizzes 10, assignments 5, attendance 5) + end-sem 60
exams.pass: Min 40/100 overall and min 18/60 in end-sem; labs min 50%
exams.hall_ticket: Download from the portal 5 days before exams. Withheld if attendance is below 75% without condonation, or fee/library dues are pending. Lost hall ticket: Exam Cell A-102 issues a provisional slip same day
exams.rules: Reach 20 min early; no entry after 30 min; phones/smartwatches banned; unfair means = paper cancelled
exams.backlogs: Supplementary exam in July, Rs 1,500 per paper. Promoted to next year with up to 4 backlogs; more than 4 means repeating the year. Improvement attempts: up to 2 subjects a year, Rs 1,500 each
exams.re_evaluation: Apply on the portal within 7 days of result. Rs 1,000 per paper (photocopy of answer sheet Rs 500). Outcome in about 15 days, marks can go up or down, revised marks are final. End-sem theory only
exams.missed_exam: Missed end-sem for genuine reason (medical, bereavement): apply to Controller of Exams (Dr. Harish Chandra Joshi, A-101) within 3 days with proof; special exam costs Rs 1,500 per paper. Missed mid-sem: ask the subject teacher and HOD for a makeup test

attendance: Minimum 75% in every subject. 65-74.99% can be condoned for medical, sports/NCC or approved college work: Rs 500 per subject, max 2 subjects per semester; apply with proof to HOD then Dean Academics before the end-sem form deadline (see calendar deadlines). Below 65%: detained in that subject (no condonation). Leave: apply on portal within 3 days of return; medical certificate needed for more than 3 days. Faculty update attendance every Friday

fees.installments: Two a year: odd sem due {-71}, even sem due {+82}
fees.late: Rs 100/day after due date, capped at Rs 3,000. After 30 days, hall ticket is withheld. One part-payment allowed with Accounts Officer's approval
fees.payment: Portal (UPI/card/net banking), DD to 'Aravali Institute of Technology', NEFT, or Accounts window A-12 (cash up to Rs 20,000)
fees.payment_failed: Money deducted but fee not updated: raise a portal ticket with transaction ID; auto-resolved in 5-7 working days
fees.refund_on_withdrawal: Before classes 100% minus Rs 10,000; within 15 days 75% of tuition; 16-30 days 50%; after 30 days none. Caution deposit Rs 10,000 refunded in 45 days after no-dues

scholarships: Merit (entry): top 10 ranks 100% tuition, ranks 11-50 get 50%, renew with CGPA 8.0+. Need-based: family income under Rs 4 lakh, up to 40%. Sports: 25%. Girl Child STEM grant (ECE/ME/CE girls): 10% first year. Apply on the portal with income and marksheets. College window closed {-55}; government scholarship verification open till {+36}. Scholarship Cell: A-14, scholarships@aravali.edu.in

hostel.blocks: Aravali Hall (boys, 1st yr), Vindhya Hall (boys, senior), Ganga Hall (girls UG), Yamuna Hall (girls PG)
hostel.rent_per_year: Triple Rs 78,000; double Rs 98,000; double AC Rs 125,000; single Rs 135,000. Mess Rs 4,200/month. Deposit Rs 10,000 refundable
hostel.curfew: Boys 10:30 PM, girls 9:30 PM. Late pass from warden extends to 11:30 PM (boys) / 10:30 PM (girls) with a department/club letter
hostel.visitors: Sundays 10 AM-5 PM in the visitors' lounge; parents any working day 10 AM-5 PM with ID
hostel.outings: Log in the leave register; overnight outside needs parent confirmation to warden
hostel.complaints: Hostel portal ticket or floor attendant; fixed in 48 hours, urgent same day. Hostel office: Vindhya Hall ground floor, 0120-4567-140
hostel.prohibited: Alcohol, smoking, hot plates, loud music after 10 PM

mess.timings: Breakfast 7:30-9 AM (weekends 8-9:30), lunch 12:30-2 PM, snacks 5-6 PM, dinner 7:30-9:30 PM

menu.Tuesday: B: aloo paratha, curd | L: chole, rice, roti, raita | S: bread pakora | D: paneer butter masala, dal fry, rice, roti
menu.Wednesday: B: idli sambar | L: kadhi pakora, rice, roti, bhindi | S: veg sandwich | D: chicken curry or paneer lababdar, rice, roti, kheer (non-veg day)
menu.Thursday: B: upma, banana | L: dal makhani, aloo matar, rice, roti | S: macaroni | D: veg biryani, raita, ice cream
menu.Friday: B: puri bhaji | L: sambar, mix veg, lemon rice, roti | S: kachori | D: egg curry or soya chaap, jeera rice, roti
menu.Saturday: B: chole kulche | L: dal, lauki, rice, roti | S: pav bhaji | D: kofta curry, pulao, roti, halwa

mess.extras: Rebate Rs 150/day if away 5+ consecutive days (apply on hostel portal a day before). Jain/no-onion-garlic meals on request. Complaint register at mess entrance. Canteens: Central Cafeteria 8:30 AM-6 PM (thali Rs 90), Chai Point 8 AM-7 PM, Night Canteen 8 PM-12:30 AM

library: Mon-Sat 8 AM-8 PM, Sun 10 AM-4 PM; reading room 24x7 for 2 weeks before end-sem. B.Tech/BCA/BBA borrow 4 books for 14 days; MBA/M.Tech 6 books for 21 days. Renew twice online. Fine Rs 2 per day per book; lost book = cost + Rs 200. Printing Rs 1/page. Group study rooms bookable on portal (2 hrs). Has IEEE, Springer, NPTEL access. Chief Librarian Mrs. Sunita Pillai, library@aravali.edu.in

transport.routes: R1 Noida Sec 18 (pickup 7:50 AM, Rs 14,000/yr); R2 Vaishali/Indirapuram (7:15 AM, Rs 16,000); R3 Greater Noida Pari Chowk (7:10 AM, Rs 15,000); R4 Laxmi Nagar/Akshardham (7:00 AM, Rs 20,000); R5 Sector 62 Metro shuttle every 15 min (Rs 6,000)
transport.timings: Buses reach campus by 8:45 AM; leave 4:45 and 5:45 PM (Friday extra at 3:30 PM)
transport.pass: Buy on portal under 'Transport', annual or per semester at half price. Route change mid-year Rs 300. Live bus tracking in the Aravali Campus app. Transport office near Main Gate: 0120-4567-160
transport.parking: Two-wheeler permit Rs 500/yr, helmet compulsory, speed limit 20 km/h

placements: Last season: 87% placed, highest 42 LPA, average 7.8 LPA, median 6.5 LPA, 210 companies (TCS, Infosys, Amazon, Microsoft, Adobe, Deloitte, Razorpay, Zomato and more). CSE average 9.4 LPA. To sit for drives: CGPA 6.0+, no active backlog, 75% attendance, no dues, registered on placement portal (final-year batch registration closes {+11}). Mandatory 8-week internship after 6th semester. Mock interviews monthly. T&P Cell: Dr. Rakesh Bhatnagar, A-201, placements@aravali.edu.in
clubs: CodeCraft (coding, hackathons), RoboX (robotics), Null Aravali (cyber security), AI Circle, Rangmanch (theatre), Sargam (music), Footloose (dance), Lens & Light (photography), Shabd (literary), E-Cell, NSS, Sports Council. Join via auditions/forms in August and January or by contacting the club lead; max 2 clubs. Duty leave counts as present if club lead submits list to HOD 3 days ahead. Dean Student Welfare: Dr. Vikram Sethi, A-205

it_services.wifi: Connect to 'Aravali-Secure', username is your roll number, set password first time on the campus site; 15 GB/day fair use. Visitors use 'Aravali-Guest' with OTP
it_services.lms: Moodle LMS, log in with student email for notes and assignments
it_services.helpdesk: Room B-G12, Mon-Fri 9-5, Sat 9-1, helpdesk@aravali.edu.in, 0120-4567-180; password reset also here

student_services.where: Student Services Centre (SSC), A Block ground floor; apply on portal, collect with ID. Mon-Fri 9:30-5:30, Sat 9:30-1. ssc@aravali.edu.in, 0120-4567-130
student_services.documents: Bonafide Rs 0 first copy (Rs 50 extra), 2 working days; character certificate Rs 100, 3 days; transcript Rs 500, 5 days; fee certificate free, 2 days; duplicate ID Rs 300, 3 days (needs photo and FIR/affidavit if lost); provisional degree Rs 300; TC Rs 200; NOC for internship/visa free, 2 days (needs offer letter + HOD approval)
student_services.lost_id: Apply for a duplicate ID on the portal, submit an affidavit or FIR copy and a photo at SSC, pay Rs 300, ready in 3 working days. Meanwhile ask security/SSC for a temporary gate pass. The library and canteen card are linked to the ID, so ask the library to block the old card
student_services.no_dues: Digital clearance from Library, Hostel, Accounts, lab and Sports; takes 3-5 working days

safety_and_grievance.ragging: Zero tolerance. Anti-Ragging Squad 24x7: +91 90000 10300, antiragging@aravali.edu.in; National Anti-Ragging Helpline 1800-180-5522; anonymous 'Safe Campus' box outside A Block. Punishment: suspension, expulsion, FIR
safety_and_grievance.harassment: ICC (Chair Prof. Kavita Nair): icc@aravali.edu.in, confidential; Women's Help Desk A-G20, 24x7 line +91 90000 10350
safety_and_grievance.grievance: Portal 'Grievance' section or box in A Block; acknowledged in 2 working days, resolved in 7; escalates to Director
safety_and_grievance.health: Health Centre near A Block 8 AM-8 PM, Dr. Farah Khan; ambulance 24x7 +91 90000 10100. Free confidential counselling: Ms. Ishita Bose, A-G18, Mon-Sat 10-5
safety_and_grievance.dress_and_phones: Smart casual; ID card mandatory; phones silent in class/library/exam

fallback: If something is not in this data, say you don't have that information and point to the right office above. If unsure, send them to the Student Services Centre (0120-4567-130) or the main helpline (0120-4567-100).
